sourceNote: Neo Genesis: WOTC vintage (1999–2002) model, confidence LOW. A pack of this era is 11 cards with a single rare slot; the only chase is the HOLO rare (Charizard, Lugia, …), which appears roughly 1 in 3 packs — so ultra_rare (Rare Holo) is set to ~0.33/pack, non-holo rares and below are bulk. Card + box prices are PriceCharting's UNLIMITED-print market (1st Edition / Shadowless trade far higher and are NOT modelled here). PRICE CAVEAT: sealed vintage boxes trade in an extremely thin, ask-skewed collector market — the box figure is indicative, not a firm transaction price. ROI is deeply negative across the whole plausible range.
